annotations.title: Change the business details on review pages

description: Changes the business details shown on the review pages: name, trade, town, brand colours, logo link or Google review link. Only the fields given change. Returns the trade page link.

company_number.description: Optional. UK Companies House number. Gives a stable nero_trade_ref, the same one Spark Pack and Nero Work use.

display_name.description: Trading name customers know, for example "Brightwire Electrical".

google_review_url.description: Optional. The business's Google "write a review" link (g.page/r/..., maps.app.goo.gl or google.com). If set, EVERY reviewer is offered it after sending their stars, whatever they gave.

licence_body.description: Optional. Competent person scheme or licence body, for example "niceic" or "napit". With licence_number it gives the nero_trade_ref.

logo_url.description: https link to the logo image (square works best). Without one, the initials are shown.

primary_colour.description: Main brand colour as hex, for example "#1F3A5F". Used for the page header and buttons. Text colour on it is picked automatically for contrast.

secondary_colour.description: Accent colour as hex, used for the level badge and the logo placeholder.

town.description: Town or area served, for example "Leeds".

trade_key.description: The trade_key that register_trade returned for this business (starts with nrk_).

trade_type.description: Short trade label shown on the pages, for example "Electrician" or "Plumbing & heating".

name: update_trade
title: Change the business details on review pages
